rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for frequency, especially “hardly ever.”

example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 siu2 daap3 dik1 si6

rows.note: Use this when something almost does not happen or is almost not the case, rather than simply happening rarely.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gei2 fu1 m4 sik1 jau4 seoi2

rows.note: Use this for “barely” or “only just,” when someone manages something with little margin.

example.english: I could hardly catch the last train.
example.jyutping: ngo5 min5 koeng5 gon2 dak1 cit3 mei5 baan1 ce1

rows.note: Use this as a rhetorical denial meaning “certainly not” or “how could that be?”

example.english: It could hardly have been me—I wasn't even there that day.
example.traditional: 點會係我做㗎？我嗰日根本唔喺度。
example.jyutping: dim2 wui5 hai6 ngo5 zou6 gaa3 ngo5 go2 jat6 gan1 bun2 m4 hai2 dou6
